refusal_behavior: 10/18 questions refused. 3/3 correctly on the truly unanswerable set (q13-15); 3 correctly on questions where retrieval had genuinely failed (q1, q7, q9) -- honest, not hallucinated; but 4 FALSE refusals (q4, q8, q16, q18) where the correct evidence was sitting directly in the supplied context and the question was simple. Net: excellent hallucination discipline, but miscalibrated toward refusing even easy, well-evidenced questions -- 'safe but frequently unhelpful' under this prompt.
